PushCredential.description:
The decrypted administrative credential, presented to the target's
authentication exchange and never persisted on it (spec §6.1).

**NO FREE-FORM MEMBER.** `username` and `secret` and nothing else; a push
cannot authenticate without them, and nothing else in the params is sealed
material (invariant #3, spec §2.4). Redacted on every API read and scrubbed
from `jobs.params` on any terminal state.
PushCredential.title: PushCredential

PushRelease.description:
The agent artefact to place: identified by version and SHA-256, server-read.

**`url` IS PRESIGNED BY THE SERVER FROM THE `agent_releases` ROW IT SELECTED**
(spec §4.2). An operator-supplied URL is an operator-supplied payload with
extra steps, so there is no field for one. The agent verifies `sha256`
against the bytes it downloads BEFORE transferring a byte to the target
(spec §11, agent falsifier 6).

url.description: Presigned, short-lived, server-minted. A bearer grant.
url.title: Url

PushRelease.title: PushRelease

description:
`agent.push_install` -- the whole instruction, and it contains no code.

Spec §4.1. Everything the endpoint acts on is here and signed; the endpoint
never decides what it may touch (spec §11): `target_address` is the one
address it may reach, and it is refused if the params name a different one
(agent falsifier 4).

enroll_token.description: Single-use, <=30 min. Delivered, never minting an identity (§7.1).
enroll_token.title: Enroll Token

enroll_url.description: The console's bare https origin (ITS_PUBLIC_CONSOLE_URL), written into the installed service's ITS_AGENT_ENROLL_URL; the agent's enrollment client appends /enroll/v1. Set on every install the server dispatches (`winrm` and `ssh`). Server configuration, never operator-authored, and never derived from the presigned release URL. Optional on the wire so the field is additive.
enroll_url.title: Enroll Url

expected_mac.description: From the promoted asset, if known. Never widened.
expected_mac.title: Expected Mac

host_key_fingerprint.description: NEVER null: the confirmed key the SSH client verifies against (§4.4, §7.3). A push to a host with no pinned, confirmed key is refused before this job exists.
host_key_fingerprint.title: Host Key Fingerprint

os.description: Operator-declared; the agent verifies it on the target (§7.2).
os.title: Os
